note: A tuning corpus, entirely separate from the frozen one in testdata/. Retrieval constants are chosen against these scenarios and then measured, once, against the frozen corpus — which is what the PRD means by tuning only on non-held-out data. Every company, city, and candidate here is invented, and none appears in the frozen corpus. Enlarged to twenty listings on 2026-08-21 so it reaches the frozen corpus's scale: a retrieval defect that only appears when aspects outnumber the per-query depth cannot be diagnosed on a corpus half that size, and diagnosing it on the frozen set is the one thing this corpus exists to prevent. The ten listings added then were rated for every scenario by one rule applied uniformly — plausible when the role's must-have skills sit in the same working domain as the candidate's. Those ratings were authored after one ranking had been seen, which is a contamination risk worth naming: the before-and-after comparison is unaffected, because both runs score against identical labels, but the absolute figure should be read with that in mind.
